systems.system: dépôt de plainte par voie électronique au CNIN
systems.owner: Centre national d'investigations numériques (CNIN), attached to the Presidency
systems.tiers: complaints on personal-data breaches and digital offences, by email; physical complaint points in Cotonou and, reported 3 October 2026, in police premises at Porto-Novo, Abomey and Parakou

note: The CNIN's complaint points are physical desks housed in police premises, for digital offences only, and the CNIN is not a police station; no digital record of the complaint is described.
